description: RFC 2231 parameter-continuation + percent-encoding smuggling: the attachment filename is split across filename*0*/filename*1* and percent-encodes '../../etc/passwd'. mail-parser decodes the continuation before the sanitizer runs, so the traversal is caught and rewritten to a safe form — parse_attachment_filename_rewritten fires. Exercises the 2231 decode path that the plain-quoted attachment-path-traversal fixture does not.
